_comment: Repair templates for the mechanically-safe subset of registry.json + MDL-00x checks. Each template is a real SPARQL 1.1 Update, run against the target document's own quads via Oxigraph. checks/repairEngine.ts binds ?focusNode/?path/?value (from the finding's ResultRow, UNDEF if not applicable), ?derivedLabel (humanized local name of focusNode), and every ProjectStandards field as pre-bound variables before executing -- see checks/repairEngine.ts's module doc comment for the full variable contract. 'kind':'insert' templates are applied as a safe text append (preserves formatting); 'kind':'replace' templates are applied by reserializing the whole document (the delta can't in general be spliced into arbitrary existing Turtle syntax without a real parser-preserving editor).

STR-005.title: Declare the domain value as a class

STR-008.title: Declare the range value as a class

QUA-001.title: Add a label derived from the local name

QUA-004.title: Add a skos:prefLabel derived from the local name

QUA-005.title: Declare an owl:Ontology resource from project standards

LOG-003.title: Remove the redundant axiom (per project policy)

MDL-003.title: Model as a Category instead (per project standards)

STY-003.title: Add the project's default language tag

PRJ-REQUIRED.title: Add a value derived from the local name
PRJ-REQUIRED._comment: Only fires when the missing predicate is rdfs:label or skos:prefLabel -- structural predicates (rdfs:comment, rdfs:domain, rdfs:range, ...) have no safe auto-generated value and are left as a flagged finding with no Quick Fix offered.
